top_signals.title: Freire Shipyard Celebrates Launch of New Greenpeace Vessel
top_signals.summary: Freire Shipyard celebrated the launch ceremony of NB 737 on November 25, 2026 in Vigo, marking a milestone in the construction of Greenpeace International's new flagship vessel. Designed to support environmental campaigns and scientific research worldwide while minimizing fossil fuel consumption…
